partition_policy.purged_cross_split: entry_date < 20260401 and scheduled_exit_date >= 20260401; retain position locks; not training or validation return denominator
partition_policy.ledger: each variant and horizon independently replays all frozen signals in chronology; never reset locks at split; signal_date strictly greater than previous proxy exit date
partition_policy.missing_future_date: retain target index; maturity before price lookup; unknown future date empty, never fabricated

training_protocol.population: immutable annual baseline D20, slippage_bps=10, entry_date < 20260401 and exit_date < 20260401; reproduce by full-signal baseline replay
training_protocol.order: baseline replay -> training-only high/low/middle feature contrasts -> freeze candidate_rules including training Q75 -> independent full-signal variant replays -> time-split summaries
training_protocol.candidate_rationale: five bounded single-feature hypotheses chosen after early-window descriptive contrasts; weak separation is not effectiveness; do not add combinations or search for better results
training_protocol.threshold_population: all valid width observations in training baseline primary positions, one observation per position; retain unresolved anomaly candidates
training_protocol.quantile_algorithm: Hyndman-Fan type 7; sort Decimal widths; index=(n-1)*0.75; linear interpolation without threshold rounding; record n and exact decimal result
training_protocol.no_training_width: width variant unsupported; no threshold invented
training_protocol.selection_forbidden: validation outcomes; full-year anomaly flags; candidate-exclusion metrics; maximum win rate; threshold grids; cross-feature combinations

variants.rule: all immutable supported selected signals; no new feature filter

variants.meaning: 400/1000四批期間各自淨增；不是同週同步增加；兩級距非互斥
三個相鄰批次變化中兩級距各至少兩次增加；不要求連續、同週或淨增
近5個有效觀測收盤未下跌；不是已完成止穩或底部確認
近20個有效觀測寬度不超過前段baseline主樣本Q75；非連續20交易日保證
當日未創前20個有效觀測新低；不稱底部完成

feature_policy.basis: immutable annual signal observed_history_dates, exactly 21 existing observations including signal date; preserve history_gap_count and do not silently require calendar-contiguous prices
feature_policy.tdcc: use immutable serialized annual delta/up-count fields; up_weeks is count of positive differences across three intervals, not consecutive weeks or joint same-week count
feature_policy.return_5d: use immutable four-decimal annual observation-lag return; do not reinterpret as five consecutive sessions
feature_policy.return_20d: use immutable four-decimal annual observation-lag return; descriptive only
feature_policy.range_20obs_pct: (Decimal(immutable high_20)/Decimal(immutable low_20)-1)*100, Decimal localcontext precision 50; serialize exact result without additional rounding; same final20 observed dates as annual v1
feature_policy.previous_20obs_low_ex_today: minimum low over first 20 of the immutable 21 observed dates; current low is final date low
feature_policy.price_state: return_20d<0 and return_5d<0: falling; return_20d<0 and return_5d>=0: short_rebound_in_decline; return_20d>=0 and return_5d>=0: nonnegative_short_and_medium; return_20d>=0 and return_5d<0: short_pullback; missing: unsupported
feature_policy.missing: required numeric or observed-date price absent/invalid -> that feature unsupported; no zero filling, forward filling, replacement sources, original signal deletion or cross-variant feature dependency
feature_policy.scope: no monthly revenue, EPS, gross margin, operating margin, operating income, non-operating income, net income, quarterly or annual financial statement data

operation_policy: unchanged annual cost cashflows and horizon semantics; D0 next frozen-calendar session open; exit calendar[entry_index+h] close; independent same-stock non-overlap; unresolved missing exit keeps lock; no intraday realized operation, no new stops or targets
anomaly_policy: Retain annual D20 candidates and horizon full_period D60 candidates by same signal_date/stock_id/horizon; add Q1/Q3 +/-3IQR candidates from each variant/horizon full-chronology mature slippage10 ledger, not separate partition thresholds. All candidates stay primary; exclusion is sensitivity only. Training contrasts use immutable annual D20 prior-only flags, never new full-year flags. No anomaly flag or sensitivity result selects parameters.
full_year_prior_exposure: annual aggregate and horizon aggregate already inspected; later partition is time-split validation/robustness, not fully blinded holdout
published_warmup_projection_policy: Exact44 signal_date/stock_id/observed_dates identities only; require canonical rows hash and exact source hashes from immutable annual contract. Missing/extra/duplicate keys fail. Full producer and full independent validator each recompute original raw window minima and compare this pre-performance reference. Published-only checks the frozen derived reference plus remaining Git prices; it does not reread private raw. No general missing-price fallback.
